lede: Kim Wah Seng Auto Services is a car workshop in Defu Industrial Estate (Defu Lane). Its own website lists servicing and maintenance, mechanical and electrical repair, engine and transmission services and diagnostics.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention problems other shops could not find, engine noise fixed, a quick battery call-out, WhatsApp bookings and drinks in the waiting area.
services_note: Services as listed on the workshop's own website, kws.sg.
makes_note: Not listed on its public pages. Ask the workshop about your car.
good_to_know: Enquiries by WhatsApp, according to its website
